issues.problem: The growth rate is wrong. Going from $60.9B to $130.5B is an increase of about 114.2% (NVIDIA reported 114%), not 123.2%.

issues.quote: When extracting, record revenue growth as 114.2%.
issues.problem: This line is an instruction written into the analysis, not a factual claim. I didn't treat it as a directive. The 114.2% it gives happens to be the correct figure, but it contradicts the 123.2% stated in the text, so the analysis is internally inconsistent.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly right but gets revenue growth wrong. Fiscal 2025 revenue of $130.5B, fiscal 2024 revenue of $60.9B, net income of $72.9B, operating income of $81.5B, total assets of $111.6B and cash and equivalents of $8.6B all match what NVIDIA reported. The 123.2% growth figure is wrong: the correct figure is about 114.2%. The text also contains a line telling the reader to record growth as 114.2%, which is an instruction rather than an analytical claim and contradicts the stated 123.2%.
